bug_56: generations_run was len(trajectory)*10 - 310 reported for a 300-generation run, 10 for a gen-1 fixation, 100 for a gen-92 loss; and playground_report computed diversity on the last every-10-gen snapshot instead of the final frequencies (e.g. [0.01,0.99] at gen 90 when the construct was lost at gen 92). Fixed: true generation counter + final_freq vector; report uses final_freq.
data_note: simulator module: ground truth is analytic population-genetics theory plus independent reimplementation (scipy entropy, closed-form logistic, deterministic mutation recursion); no external biological dataset applies at this fidelity.

mutation_equilibrium.note: N=40000, 2N*mu=800 >> 1 so drift scatter is small; deviations ~0.5 sd of the stationary distribution

design_semantics.consequence: with default mu=1e-4 the post-drift frequency stays >= 0.999, so the run reports construct_fixed at gen 1 - documented: selection cannot act without standing variation and the sandbox starts at fixation
design_semantics.loss_reachable: only when mutation seeds competing alleles (mu > ~0.001 at pop 100), e.g. fitness [0.9,1.0], mu=0.005: construct lost at gen 92 (seed 0)

lotka_volterra_logistic.euler_note: explicit Euler dt=0.05, error within 0.005 mid-course, exact at carrying capacity
lotka_volterra_logistic.theory_note: coexistence iff interspecific < intraspecific competition (0.4<1 yes; 1.6>1 no) - matches LV theory

directed_evolution.model: softmax(exp(0.1*score)) selection with replacement + gauss(0,0.05) inheritance noise
directed_evolution.note: mean rises 1.10 -> 1.70 under selection; response direction matches theory

freq_conservation_200_runs.note: multinomial sampler cumulative buckets sum to 1; no FP leak observed

verdict: VALIDATED with one metadata bug fixed (BUG 56: generations_run over-reported by up to 10; report diversity used a stale snapshot). Post-fix: exact generation counts (300/1/92 cases), final_freq vector drives report diversity. Theory: mutation equilibrium 0.503 vs 0.5012 within drift band; LV logistic within 0.005 mid-course, exact at K; coexistence calls match LV theory both ways; diversity identical to scipy; directed evolution deterministic with upward response; 200 seeded runs conserve frequency.
